scenarios.label: Editable campaign link
scenarios.detail: Marketing may change the destination after publication.

scenarios.label: Stable documentation alias
scenarios.detail: The destination is versioned and intended to remain permanent.

scenarios.label: Temporary method-preserving hop
scenarios.detail: A non-GET request must retain its method and body.

statuses.label: 301 Moved Permanently
statuses.detail: Clients and intermediaries may remember the destination.

statuses.label: 302 Found
statuses.detail: A temporary redirect suitable for changeable GET links.

statuses.label: 307 Temporary Redirect
statuses.detail: Temporary and explicitly preserves method and body.

analyticsModes.label: Synchronous counter write
analyticsModes.detail: The redirect waits for analytics storage.

analyticsModes.label: Asynchronous click event
analyticsModes.detail: The redirect emits an event and returns without waiting for aggregation.
